design.concrete_example: C fa ut has fa in the hard hexachord based on Gamma and ut in the natural hexachord based on C. The source lists fa→ut ascending into the natural hexachord, and ut→fa descending into the hard hexachord. F fa ut repeats the same syllable pair but uses natural C and soft F origins. G sol re ut explicitly lists all six ordered mutations among three voices in an argued order. B-flat and B-natural are expressly different pitches, hence not a legal mutation pair. Gamma and several other terminal/single-voice keys explicitly have no mutation.
design.decision: Retain one raw source-supported architecture; NO decoder or target fit until complete source collation, finite compiler and whole target coverage law are independently frozen. No further source collection requested automatically.
design.limits: No observed Voynich unit is assigned. A whole-register target boundary and explicit serialization still require selection. A free melody path through this automaton is not the same hypothesis and could leave pitches or absolute register unidentified. Six-syllable-only fixed full-line morphisms remain subject to existing rank obstructions; do not add arbitrary pitch alphabets as a repair. Register/origin and syllable automorphisms must be tested on the complete source before semantic claims. The final ee la is explicitly called an addition by moderns in the source and must be retained under a declared witness scope, not silently removed.
design.mechanism: A conditional whole-register compiler would serialize every pitch record, all its voice/cantus/origin memberships, and every listed directed mutation with direction and destination origin, using one globally reused primitive code and fixed source order. Same pitch before and after a mutation is a source-defined invariant; destination voice and origin must agree with the membership table. Complete negative/zero records are obligatory. Pitch-specific opaque payload macros and free source addresses are disallowed. This is a candidate compiler contract, not an assertion that the source supplies an authorial cipher serialization.
design.novelty: The source supplies explicit operations and their state constraints rather than a retrospectively inferred thematic graph. Repeated syllable transitions occur under different origins, while pitch invariance forbids transitions that generic six-syllable substitution would permit. Compared with GDT899 prognosis conditions this is a finite state-transition register with checkable same-pitch semantics; general novelty and target observability remain unreviewed.

design.decisions: H=F closes this entire exact fixed-literal reversible common-endpoint class on the frozen line scope, with no larger-state repair. Proper H keeps the class logically possible and yields a reproducible countermachine, not a decipherment. Complete finite-index core permits a separate all-compatible-orbit analysis only if independently selected. Budget or validation failure remains UNKNOWN. No outcome yields a language, lexical value or historical provenance.
design.exact_reduction: Use a right action of the free group F on the observed character alphabet. With fixed reference word w0, set H=<wi*w0^-1> as an ORDINARY subgroup, not its normal closure. The endpoint equations s.wi=s.w0 hold exactly when H is contained in Stab(s). Thus H=F forces every character to fix the start in every finite or infinite reversible action. If H is proper, its coset action supplies a nontrivial compatible action; finite graph completion supplies a finite example as well. Left-action conventions require the corresponding consistently reversed difference convention.
design.finite_algorithm: Build a based bouquet of the finitely many reduced difference words and fold both deterministic and inverse-deterministic edge conflicts. The finite based core represents H exactly. A one-vertex core with every generator loop certifies H=F. Any proper core can be extended to a finite covering by completing each generator's partial permutation; if needed add a vertex before completion so the orbit remains nontrivial. This is one complete subgroup decision, not a state4/5/etc search or a normal-closure computation.
design.predecessors: GDT882 excludes nontrivial additive common-line values on its fixed413-line,43-odd-leaf,20-literal-character scope. Its solvable-group constant-product corollary does not equate common action endpoints with equal group elements. GDT885 correctly permits an arbitrary common endpoint and excludes nontrivial start orbits on at most3 states. No reset-to-start assumption may be introduced.
design.scope: Reuse exactly the existing882 odd literal complete-line projection and reference, with all exclusions and alternate-reading concordance unchanged. No even or sealed input, new images, normalization, segmentation, errors, contextual letters, changed endpoints or selected subsets. This proposal performs no actual line fold; GDT903 owns implementation, validation and publication under its separately frozen decision.
design.sources: John R.Stallings, Topology of finite graphs, Inventiones Mathematicae71(1983),551–565, https://doi.org/10.1007/BF02095993 . Ilya Kapovich and Alexei Myasnikov, Stallings foldings and subgroups of free groups, Journal of Algebra248(2002),608–668; author preprint https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0202285 . Folding/coset-graph framework supplies the subgroup method; the manuscript endpoint reduction and research scope are the explicit conditional application here.
design.stronger_output: If the core is already a complete finite covering of degree d, H has finite index d. Every compatible start orbit is a quotient of H-backslash-F, corresponding to H contained in a stabilizer K, and therefore has size at most d, dividing d. This constrains active orbits, not disconnected inaccessible states. If the core is partial, a chosen completion is only a countermachine to universal exclusion, not a uniquely reconstructed historical machine. Its arbitrary missing transitions must not be advertised as predictions.

The recipe reading predicts a reusable operator-position whole between input and state, plus a distinct output/closure position; a state-like neighbor alone cannot count as the operation.

assumption_costs: The f57v four-plus-four grouping is source-bound and semantically co-owned.
A plant-transformation system can be represented without visible plant names or confirmed Voynich lexemes.
The historical three-method inventory is an analogue, not a licence to assign graft words.
concrete_observations: RAW_P30/GDT389 records four short f57v inscriptions near figures and four additional inscriptions between consecutive figures, with no drawn leader or bracket assigning a nearby item to one figure.

Columella, De Arboribus 26.1.1 explicitly distinguishes three methods: a split stock receiving scions, insertion between bark and wood, and budding under bark; it also states season and bark/fruit similarity constraints.

Palladius, De insitione 34-39 gives the same three-way technique inventory and then lists directed tree pairings whose graft changes fruit colour, size, flesh or thorniness; some trees exchange their own buds rather than accept an alien one.
design.contrast: Gerichteter Donor-Stock- und Ergebnisgraph versus zwei parallele räumliche Beschriftungsregister.
design.distinguishing_observation: Freeze the four endpoint pairs in their recorded cyclic order and compare exact intervening forms across repeated or reversed pair classes. A positive result needs direction-sensitive bridge reuse plus an endpoint change; adjacency alone is not evidence.
linked_consequences: A source-like f57v reading requires every bridge to carry both an ordered endpoint pair and one method/compatibility class; a reverse pair cannot silently preserve the same relation.

It predicts a constrained output change at the following endpoint (for example colour, size, protection or fertility), while a bridge between incompatible endpoint classes should be exceptional or marked as failed.
The parallel-register rival predicts no systematic co-variation between endpoint pair order, intervening inscription and downstream endpoint, even if all eight items form a neat circle.
design.mechanism: Each endpoint is a host or donor plant state; an intervening item records a directed graft method or compatibility relation, and the next endpoint records the inherited or altered product trait.
design.nearest_rival: Two independent cyclic lists placed together, with proximity and cyclic adjacency serving layout only; a repeated gap form is a reusable label rather than a donor-stock operation.
design.prediction: A graft graph predicts that reversing an endpoint pair changes the legal relation or result, and that repeated host/donor classes reuse one of the three method families. The parallel-list model predicts no direction-sensitive bridge and allows the gap texts to vary independently of endpoint pairs.

primary_sources.source_consequence: Three methods, compatibility conditions and seasonal distinctions are written explicitly; method is separate from host/donor names.
Directed pairings produce altered fruit traits and include a non-accepting/self-exchanging exception.

design.scope_description: Nur die bereits gebundene f57v-Visualbeschreibung mit vier figurnahen und vier Zwischenfigurtexten sowie der zugängliche antike/lateinische Grafting-Vergleich; keine neue Bildauswertung.
design.strongest_likely_failure: f57v has no visible leaders and only four pairs; apparent endpoint-dependent bridges may be circular layout coincidence, leaving this stronger graph model indistinguishable from P30's independent-register rival.
design.unit: The four cyclic endpoint inscriptions and four interfigure inscriptions recorded in the existing f57v source-bound report.

summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: Columella/Palladius describe ordered graft relations with three insertion methods, stock-donor compatibility and altered fruit traits; the bound f57v four-near/four-between layout could encode transformations rather than two independent label lists.
title: RAW_UNSCREENED: Graftkompatibilität als gerichteter Donor-Stock-Graph

assumption_costs: Aristotelian embryology is a historically relevant content analogue for this section.
The f101r three-paragraph order is meaningful rather than a layout accident.
Count/class and source/branch distinctions must be written or structurally recoverable; no absent labels may be invented.
concrete_observations: GDT812 records f101r as three paragraphs in ten lines across two visual text bands; its displaced lower vessel is real but has no local label to track.

Aristotle, History of Animals VII, records four vessels entering large animal embryos, two in smaller animals and one in very small animals such as fowl; two pass through the liver toward the great vein and two run toward the aorta.

Aristotle, Parts of Animals III, states that the heart is formed first and is the source/origin of the vessels; this supplies an ordered source-before-branches rule rather than a free vessel inventory.
design.contrast: Vergleichender Entwicklungs-/Verzweigungsbericht versus hydraulische Apparatur- oder allgemeine Gefäßbeschreibung.
design.distinguishing_observation: Using only the existing f101r paragraph order and vessel-location record, look for a repeated source-before-branch ordering plus a non-arbitrary count/class contrast. A vessel label or displaced position alone does not distinguish the models.
linked_consequences: A developmental reading requires one source-first role and a repeated two-destination partition; the same target paragraph cannot treat every vessel as an equal peer label.

It predicts a count-changing or class-changing mark attached to the 4/2/1 cases, with a two-branch split where four vessels are described; an apparatus reading has no reason to preserve that count relation.

The displaced f101r vessel would be meaningful only if the bound paragraph order supplies a source/branch or terminal relation; absent that, it remains a layout observation and cannot support the model.
design.mechanism: A whole passage describes a developmental tree: one central origin appears first, vessels branch toward two destination systems, and the record changes branch count with the animal/developmental class.
design.nearest_rival: A technical hydraulic or anatomical apparatus description in which centrality, displacement and branching are geometric positions without embryological time or organism-class comparison.
design.prediction: The embryology model predicts a single source role, an explicit two-way branch partition and a controlled 4/2/1 count contrast across organism classes; the apparatus model predicts vessel geometry, inlet/outlet or displacement relations without a species/count hierarchy.

primary_sources.locator: History of Animals VII, umbilical vessels
primary_sources.source_consequence: The source explicitly gives 4/2/1 vessel counts by animal size and a two-direction split through liver versus toward aorta.

primary_sources.locator: Parts of Animals III, heart and vessel origin
primary_sources.source_consequence: The heart is described as formed first and as the source of blood/vessels.

primary_sources.locator: De generatione animalium, Bekker Greek edition
primary_sources.source_consequence: Primary Greek witness metadata fixes the work and edition for later source checking; no target meaning is inferred.

design.scope_description: Nur die bereits gebundene f101r-Beschreibung aus GDT812 (verschobenes unteres Gefäß, drei Absätze in zwei Textbändern, keine lokalen Labels) und die zugänglichen Aristotelian primary witnesses; kein neuer Seiten- oder Bildzugriff.
design.strongest_likely_failure: GDT812 found no local f101r labels and the page's vessel displacement has no bound owner; the 4/2/1 source rule may therefore be impossible to observe, while GDT940 already shows that a fixed vessel-name extension lacks meaning binding.
design.unit: The three complete f101r paragraphs and the displaced lower vessel in the existing GDT812 visual/text review.

summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: Aristotle's primary zoological account fixes a developmental source, two destination directions and species-dependent vessel counts; the bound f101r vessel-plus-three-paragraph layout could encode a comparative progression rather than a generic apparatus.
title: RAW_UNSCREENED: Embryonale Gefäßentwicklung als Zentralquelle-und-Zweigbericht

assumption_costs: Pliny's feature-and-exception architecture is a historical analogue, not a Voynich key.
Target parent, variant, feature and use slots must be independently observable.
The exception cannot be inferred from a line end or an arbitrary rare form.
design.external_primary: Pliny, Natural History XV, fruit-tree varieties and preservation, Perseus: https://www.perseus.tufts.edu/hopper/text?doc=Perseus%3Aabo%3Aphi%2C0978%2C001%3A15
design.mechanism: A descriptive natural-history register first identifies a parent whole, then assigns one feature-defined variant; an exception changes the allowed preservation or use relation. The feature is content, not an assumed spelling class.
design.nearest_rival: The parallel part-list reading in GDT625/GDT768.
design.observable_difference: Freeze complete entries and independently code feature contrasts before assigning meanings. Reading A predicts that a parent/variant frame carries one selected feature slot, that incompatible feature values do not co-occur within that slot, and that the exceptional frame is the only one with a changed downstream use/result. Reading B permits co-occurring part/state fields without an exclusivity or exception transition. A repeated form by itself is not evidence.
design.reading_a: A feature-taxonomy record: one parent material or plant class is followed by mutually exclusive variant/part descriptors, and one exceptional descriptor licenses a different use or preservation relation.
design.reading_b: A flat part-and-state inventory: adjacent nominal fields are co-present components or preparation states; no field excludes another and no exceptional relation changes the record's legal continuation.
design.smallest_test: Within already admitted complete Herbal entries, identify a source-independent parent/variant boundary and test one held feature contrast plus one held exception-to-use consequence. Stop if the supposed feature and exception labels are inherited from guessed glosses.
design.source_example: The passage distinguishes named apples by colour, resemblance, shape, origin, flavour, ripening speed and seed absence; it then says apples and pears are stored like grapes, with a named fruit exception in the preservation claim. These are feature and exception relations, not synonyms.
design.strongest_likely_failure: The admitted f17r.5 line has several adjacent part-like fields but no independent feature or exception marker, leaving taxonomy and inventory observationally equivalent.
design.target_endpoint: The already admitted complete Herbal surface f17r.5 in GDT625/GDT768: `ychekchy cthy chor shor cphor cphaldy dair cthey qody`, plus the already admitted f29v.1 complete prefix containing `kooiin shor chetchy ... cthy ...`.

summary: A Pliny fruit passage supplies a content system in which one named whole is split into variants by independently stated shape, colour, taste, origin or ripening features, with an explicit preparation exception. On an admitted Herbal line this predicts mutually exclusive feature slots and a marked exception, beyond whole-form recurrence.
title: RAW_UNSCREENED: Named variant classes with a diagnostic feature and exception

assumption_costs: Celsus supplies a content architecture, not a Voynich translation.
Condition, carrier and endpoint must be independently coded rather than borrowed from old glosses.
The source's polarity order must be treated as a falsifiable relation, not as a synonym list.
design.external_primary: Celsus, De Medicina 4.15.1.1, Packard Humanities Institute: https://latin.packhum.org/loc/836/2/260
design.mechanism: A clinical paragraph encodes observation, diagnosis branch, conditional fallback, ordered interventions and endpoint; the interventions can reverse a property while preserving the patient/complaint frame.
design.nearest_rival: GDT625's two parallel plant-part/state descriptions, including its preferred reading of f29v.4.
design.observable_difference: Reading A predicts one independently recurrent condition slot before a branch, a stable ordered pair of opposite state changes on the same carrier, and a distinct terminal endpoint; reversing the pair changes the clinical result. Reading B predicts no branch-dependent choice and allows the two state/part fields to co-occur without an endpoint transition. No English action is assigned in advance.
design.reading_a: A diagnostic/process record: a condition selects one branch, two successive interventions alter a shared carrier in opposite directions, and a final endpoint closes the case.
design.reading_b: A descriptive part-state record: the apparent polarity pair is two co-present material states or parts, with no diagnosis, conditional branch, or temporal result.
design.smallest_test: Use only the existing f29v.1/f29v.4 complete lines and frozen boundaries. Seek a repeated condition-before-branch frame and a held polarity/order consequence; a mere dry/moist adjacency or assigned carrier is insufficient.
design.source_example: Celsus separates acute from longer liver disease by signs; gives bloodletting first; says the abdomen is to be loosened if necessary; then orders external poultices, first those that restrain and then warm ones that draw, followed by a malagma. The conditional and the ordered polarity pair are explicit.
design.strongest_likely_failure: The admitted lines expose no written condition or independent result, so process and inventory readings can be relabelled to fit the same surfaces.
design.target_endpoint: The already admitted complete Herbal line f29v.4 from GDT625: `ysho otshy okaiin cthy oltchy s shot sho okaiin`; f29v.1 is the paired complete local line in the same registered source report.

summary: Celsus gives a compact diagnostic chain with acute/chronic alternatives, a conditional fallback, a first restraining and then warming/drawing treatment, and a named final preparation. This supplies a branch plus changed outcome consequence for an admitted Herbal line, beyond repeated words.
title: RAW_UNSCREENED: Conditional diagnosis with an ordered polarity reversal

assumption_costs: The source's epistemic convention may not belong to the target register.
Attribution and correction cues need independent visual or textual evidence.
No prior working gloss may be used as a correction marker.
design.mechanism: A source report distinguishes an observed feature from a prior explanation that experience rejects; a later finite classification records the corrected alternatives. The semantic change is commitment status and replacement, not form repetition.
design.nearest_rival: A flat nominal inventory or feature taxonomy, including the Pliny XV variant model above.
design.observable_difference: Reading A predicts a stable commitment transition: an attributed/uncertain claim is followed by a correction marker and a replacement consequence, with the same subject carried across the transition. Reading B predicts no change in commitment status and permits equivalent co-listing. The distinction requires a written correction or attribution cue; a rare word or line position cannot supply it.
design.reading_a: A report/correction register: one clause records an observation, another marks an inherited or attributed explanation as rejected, and a later field states the corrected class or consequence.
design.reading_b: A neutral inventory/classification: all neighbouring cells are assertions of equal status; apparent contrast is merely a list of parts, variants or states.
design.smallest_test: Across already admitted complete Herbal entries, freeze any independently observable attribution/correction cue and test one held replacement consequence. If no such cue exists, retain both readings without assigning an evidential meaning.
design.source_example: Pliny reports the belief that box slips from an untrimmed tree would survive, then says experience has ended that notion; in the same chapter he enumerates five vine support arrangements. The passage thus contains report, rejected explanation and corrected classification.
design.strongest_likely_failure: The admitted target lines contain no independently bound claim, attribution or correction fields; the proposal would then be a source precedent without a target consequence.
design.target_endpoint: The already admitted complete f17r.5 Herbal record in GDT768, where `cthy chor shor` are consecutive part-like cells followed by later fields, and the complete f29v.1 local record in GDT625.

summary: Pliny's vine passage preserves a concrete report, an attributed contrary belief, and an experience-based correction while also enumerating five support classes. A target reading could therefore encode evidential commitment and correction, rather than treating every adjacent noun as a stable object list.
title: RAW_UNSCREENED: Observation versus rejected explanation in a natural-history entry

assumption_costs: Die Tabula liefert eine Inhaltsarchitektur, keine Voynich-Semantik oder historische Sprachzuweisung.
Die f66r-Gruppen müssten unabhängig von vermuteten musdel/musmel-Glossen als gerichtete Übergänge erkennbar sein.
Ein räumliches Oben/Unten darf nicht automatisch als alchemische Auf-/Abwärtsoperation interpretiert werden.
Die lateinische Textüberlieferung und ihre Datierung sind nicht einheitlich; der Wikisource-Text ist als Transkription, der Biblissima-Eintrag als Zeugenkatalog zu behandeln.
design.external_primary: Tabula Smaragdina, lateinische Texttranskription: https://la.wikisource.org/wiki/Tabula_Smaragdina ; mittelalterlicher Textzeuge/Kataloghinweis: https://portail.biblissima.fr/ark:/43093/mdatacaf6585bcf17936b0c07a892d4fae49a265f9698
design.mechanism: Relationale Rollen und gerichtete Operationen tragen die Bedeutung: ein Referent kann nacheinander Herkunft, Träger, Aufnahmeort und Transformationszustand erhalten. Die Wiederverwendung einer Form müsste daher eine Rollenverschiebung oder Zustandsfortsetzung markieren, nicht zwingend dasselbe isolierte Lexem.
design.nearest_rival: GDT956 Modell C, getrennte lokale Labels, sowie IDEA000128 Llulls Kombinationsalphabet. Llull ist eine andere, kombinatorische Bedeutungswahl; diese Karte behauptet keine ungeordnete Buchstabenmischung.
design.observable_difference: A verlangt innerhalb des schon dokumentierten oberen/unteren Verbunds eine unabhängig sichtbare gerichtete Folge mit einem Vorher-/Nachher-Anschluss: mindestens ein Gruppenkontakt muss als Übergang zwischen zwei verschiedenen Relationsslots formulierbar sein, und ein späteres Glied muss gegenüber dem früheren eine andere Zustandsfunktion haben. B lässt dieselben Gruppen als gleichrangige Labels ohne solche Übergänge zu. Ein bloßer Formwiederholung oder eine nachträglich gesetzte Glosse zählt nicht.
design.reading_a: Eine kompakte Prozessnotiz: die Gruppen bilden eine gerichtete Kette aus Referent/Quelle, Träger oder Ort, Trennung und anschließendem Zustands- oder Ergebnisglied. Eine wiederaufgenommene Form dürfte in einem neuen Relationsslot stehen; die räumliche Folge muss vor und nach der Operation asymmetrisch sein.
design.reading_b: Eine Beschriftungs- oder Inventarliste: jede Gruppe bezeichnet ein stabiles Objekt, Teil oder Lebensmittel; ihre Reihenfolge ist redaktionell/visuell und es gibt keinen Zustandswechsel. Gleiche Formen können dabei dieselbe Benennung tragen, ohne Rollenverschiebung.
design.smallest_test: Nur die vorhandene GDT956-Gruppierung verwenden und vor jeder Wortglosse eine positionsblinde Tabelle der Kontakte/Übergänge erstellen. Die Prozesslesung bleibt nur dann unterscheidbar, wenn ein Übergang und ein nachfolgender Ergebnisstatus aus der Anordnung selbst festgelegt werden; sonst RAW_UNSCREENED ohne Auswahl.
design.source_example: Der Text reiht die Rollen Vater Sonne, Mutter Mond, Wind als Träger und Erde als Nährerin; danach folgen das Abtrennen von Erde/Feuer und das Aufsteigen und Wiederabsteigen mit Aufnahme oberer und unterer Kräfte. Kurzbeleg: "Pater eius est sol, mater eius luna; portavit illud ventus in ventre suo; nutrix eius terra est." Die Quelle ist eine mittelalterliche lateinische Überlieferung mit unsicherer Recensionsgeschichte; sie ist kein Codebuch für Voynich-Formen.
design.strongest_likely_failure: Das f66r-Objekt zeigt zwar getrennte Gruppen, aber keinen unabhängig sichtbaren Operator und keinen prüfbaren Vorher-/Nachher-Zustand; dann können Prozesskette und stabile Beschriftung dieselben Anordnungen erklären.
design.target_endpoint: Das bereits zugelassene vollständige f66r-Randobjekt in GDT956: obere isolierte Gruppe plus drei untere Gruppen um die anthropomorph wirkende Figur/das Gefäß, dokumentiert in experiments/yolo/gdt956_f66r_contextual_marginal_reading/REPORT.md und artifacts/CANDIDATE_TABLE.tsv. Keine neue Seite, Transkription oder Bildauswertung.

summary: Die mittelalterliche lateinische Tabula smaragdina verbindet einen einzigen impliziten Gegenstand mit Vater/Mutter, Träger, Nährboden, Trennung und Auf-/Abstieg. Als historische Analogie erlaubt dies eine nichtliterale Prozesslesung bereits zugelassener Randgruppen; die Rivalhypothese bleibt ein Inventar stabiler Objekt- oder Bildlabels.
title: RAW_UNSCREENED: Tabula-Smaragdina-Rollen als sequenzielle Prozessnotation

assumption_costs: Die Geomantia liefert eine historische Rollenarchitektur, aber keinen Voynich-Schlüssel und keine bestätigten Bedeutungen.
Die 15 f66r-Gruppen müssten als drei 4er-Blöcke plus 2+1-Schlussblock unabhängig von englischen Glossen erkennbar sein.
Komponentenwiederverwendung in den letzten drei Gruppen darf nicht aus der vermuteten Figurenrechnung nachträglich erzeugt werden.
Die mittelalterliche Geomantia ist eine Kompilation mit umstrittener Zuschreibung; die konkrete Rollenpassage stammt aus gedruckten Manuskriptzeugen, nicht aus einem einheitlichen Autorencode.
design.external_primary: Beccarisi, Qualche considerazione sulla Geomantia attribuita a Guglielmo di Moerbeke (2019), diplomatische Auszüge aus Geomantia K1rb/K2r und Clm 398 f.74r, gedruckt S.587: https://www.e-theca.net/QuadernidiNoctua/Issues/2019%2C%20volume%205/Alessandra%20Beccarisi%20%E2%80%93%20Qualche%20considerazione%20sulla%20Geomantia%20attribuita%20a%20Guglielmo%20di%20Moerbeke.pdf
design.mechanism: Die sichtbaren Gruppen werden als Rollen eines erzeugten Registers gelesen: 4+4+4 Gruppen tragen Vergangenheit, Gegenwart und Zukunft; 2 Testes vermitteln die beiden Seiten; 1 Iudex bildet die Schlussfolgerung. Die spätere Rolle ist damit inhaltlich von früheren Gruppen abhängig, auch wenn einzelne Formen wiederkehren oder variieren.
design.nearest_rival: GDT957s injektive Figuren-Key-Lesung und die gleichrangige Label-Lesung. IDEA000128 behandelt Llulls Buchstaben als kombinatorische Bedeutungswahl; diese Karte verlangt dagegen zeitliche Slots und einen abhängigen Schluss, nicht bloße Kammerkombination.
design.observable_difference: A sagt eine feste Abhängigkeit der letzten drei Positionen vom vorherigen 12er-Block voraus: Test- und Schlussgruppen müssen mindestens ein bereits eingeführtes Komponenten- oder Relationssignal aufnehmen und dürfen keinen völlig neuen, unabhängigen Sachbereich eröffnen; außerdem muss ein Positionswechsel zwischen den drei 4er-Blöcken die behauptete Zeitrolle ändern. B erlaubt 15 unabhängige Labels und deshalb auch eine Permutation der Gruppen ohne systematischen Schlussanschluss. Ein bloßes Auftreten gleicher Formen genügt nicht.
design.reading_a: Ein zeitlich gerichtetes geomantisches Register: Gruppen 1–4, 5–8 und 9–12 bilden drei semantisch verschiedene Zeitblöcke; Gruppen 13–14 sind relationale Zeugen und Gruppe 15 ist eine abhängige Schlussrolle. Der Schluss darf eine zusammengesetzte oder wiederaufgenommene Form tragen, ohne ein neues unabhängiges Objekt zu benennen.
design.reading_b: Eine unabhängige Figuren-/Objektliste: alle 15 Gruppen sind gleichrangige Namen oder Einträge, jede Position kann unabhängig permutiert werden; die letzten drei Gruppen brauchen weder Abhängigkeit noch zeitliche Funktion.
design.smallest_test: Auf dem bereits registrierten GDT957-Objekt vor jeder Glosse eine positionsblinde Tabelle der 15 Gruppen und ihrer wiederverwendeten Teilformen erstellen. Nur wenn 13–15 strukturell an 1–12 anschließen und 1–4/5–8/9–12 eine unabhängige Blockdifferenz zeigen, entsteht eine neue semantische Vorhersage; sonst bleibt die Karte ungetestet.
design.source_example: Der mittelalterliche Text sagt, dass die vier Matres das Vergangene, die vier Filiae das Gegenwärtige und die vier Nepotes das Zukünftige erkennen; Testes und Iudex liefern die conclusio. Als Sonderfall wird die gewöhnliche erste Hauszuweisung für Abwesende, Herren, Knechte, Kleriker, Gefangene und Ausgestoßene geändert. Kurzer Primärabdruck: "conclusio cognoscitur autem per puncta disparia Testium et Iudicis". Die Zuschreibung an Moerbeke und die Kompilationsgeschichte sind umstritten; die Rollenpassage ist dennoch als mittelalterlicher Textzeuge/Edition dokumentiert.
design.strongest_likely_failure: GDT957s 15 Gruppen zeigen weder einen unabhängigen 4+4+4-Blockwechsel noch einen strukturellen Anschluss von Testes/Iudex an die ersten 12; dann bleibt die neue Rollenlesung ebenso frei permutierbar wie die alte Figurenliste.
design.target_endpoint: Das bereits zugelassene vollständige f66r-Randobjekt in GDT957: 15 Gruppen mit unbekanntem Figuren-/Schlüsselwert, für die der injektive Figurenvergleich keine Bedeutungsinformation lieferte. Verwendet werden nur die schon registrierten Gruppenpositionen und ihre sichtbaren Formen; keine neue Seite, Transkription oder Bildauswertung.

summary: Ein gedruckter Primärquellenabdruck der mittelalterlichen Geomantia ordnet vier Matres, vier Filiae, vier Nepotes sowie Testes und Iudex verschiedenen Zeit- und Schlussfunktionen zu. Für das bereits zugelassene 15-Gruppen-Objekt f66r ergibt das eine nichtinjektive Rollenlesung mit abhängigem Schlussblock als konkreter Rivalität zur unabhängigen Figurenliste.
title: RAW_UNSCREENED: Geomantia mit Zeitblöcken und Schlussrollen

assumption_costs: Die Beobachtung entstand nach Zielkontakt und ist daher nicht blind; sie darf nur als explorative Rohhypothese gelten.
Turner 1655 ist ein später, pseudo-Agrippa zugeschriebener Zeuge und keine sichere Quelle für die Manuskriptsprache.
Die drei historischen Elementtabellen können unterschiedliche Systeme oder Terminologien bewahren und müssen getrennt bleiben.
Ein gleicher Rest kann durch formale Morphologie entstehen, ohne eine semantische Klasse zu tragen.
Alle 15 Formen und 32 vollständigen Kandidaten müssen bereits im GDT957-Scope liegen; fehlende Zellen sind UNKNOWN und werden nicht ergänzt.
design.budget: 30 Minuten total: 5 Minuten Tabellen-/Formfamilienliste, 15 Minuten vollständige 15x3x32x2-Kreuzprüfung, 5 Minuten unabhängige Gegenkontrolle, 5 Minuten kompakter Bericht. Bei fehlender Zelle oder Tabellenkonflikt vorzeitig stoppen.
design.external_primary: Robert Turner, Of Geomancy (1655), vollständige zugängliche Transkription: https://www.princeton.edu/~ezb/geomancy/agrippa.html ; bestehende Quellenübersicht und getrennte historische Elementtabellen: research_registry/work_batches/seven_hours_20260914/GEOMANCY_LATE_SOURCE_AND_CONTRACT_REVIEW.md
design.falsifier: Ein bereits zugelassener vollständiger Chartkandidat, der innerhalb derselben vollständigen ary-Restfamilie zwei verschiedene Elemente verlangt, oder ein unauflösbarer Widerspruch zwischen den drei vorab getrennten historischen Tabellen, falsifiziert die Klassenlesung für diesen Scope.
design.mechanism: Nicht der einzelne Anfangsbuchstabe, sondern der gemeinsame vollständige Rest wird als semantischer Klassenoperator gelesen. Ein Anfang kann die konkrete geomantische Figur oder Unterrolle unterscheiden, während ary eine übergeordnete Elementklasse (zunächst nur als FIRE-Kandidat) wiederverwendet.
design.nearest_rival: IDEA000129/GDT957s vollständige geomantische Rechenregel ohne semantischen Restoperator sowie IDEA000635s reine Initial-/Kopfstruktur. Diese Karte behauptet eine Klassenbedeutung des vollständigen Restes, nicht dass Initialen lateinische Anfangsbuchstaben seien.
design.observable_difference: A sagt eine Rest-invariante Elementzuordnung voraus: jede vollständige ary-Familie muss unter jedem überlebenden Chartkandidaten und in jeder separat geführten historischen Tabelle dieselbe Elementklasse erhalten; wechselnde Anfangsteile dürfen die Unterfigur ändern, aber nicht das Element. B erlaubt innerhalb derselben ary-Familie Elementwechsel oder lediglich chart-/positionsabhängige Werte. Ein FIRE-Treffer der drei zuerst bemerkten Formen reicht ausdrücklich nicht.
design.reading_a: Eine morphologisch-geomantische Klassenlesung: alle vollständigen Wörter mit Rest ary teilen eine Elementklasse; der variable Erstteil unterscheidet Figur/Unterrolle. Die Klasse wird nur dann angenommen, wenn sie bei allen 15 Formen, beiden Richtungen, allen 32 vollständigen IT-Kandidaten und allen drei vorab getrennten historischen Elementtabellen stabil bleibt.
design.reading_b: Ein formaler Rest ohne semantische Kraft: ary ist ein strukturell häufiger Stamm oder Zufall; Elementwerte hängen von der vollständigen Figur, Position oder Tabelle ab. Gleicher Rest darf daher verschiedene Elemente tragen, ohne dass die Schreibform eine Elementklasse kodiert.
design.smallest_test: In einem vorab fixierten 30-Minuten-Vergleich alle initialen Einzelbuchstabenfamilien und alle identischen vollständigen Reste der 15 Formen in allen drei Editionen erfassen, dann nur die 32 bereits vollständigen IT-Chartkandidaten in beiden Richtungen gegen die drei getrennten historischen Elementtabellen kreuzen. Keine neue Auswahl, kein Key-Tausch und keine Bedeutungsbestätigung; bei Tabellenkonflikt oder einem stabilen Rest-internen Elementwechsel abbrechen.
design.source_example: Turners spät überlieferte geomantische Tabellen ordnen Figuren und Planetentriplikitäten elementaren Gruppen zu. Der historische Mechanismus ist eine Klassenzuordnung über eine feste Form-/Figurenfamilie, nicht die Behauptung, dass ary im Manuskript Englisch oder Latein bedeutet. Turner 1655 ist ein später, Agrippa zugeschriebener Zeuge; die drei vorhandenen Elementtabellen dürfen nicht zusammengelegt werden.
design.strongest_likely_failure: Die drei FIRE-Zuordnungen zerfallen beim vollständigen Familienvergleich, bei der Gegenrichtung oder zwischen den getrennten Elementtabellen; dann bleibt ary ein posthoc formaler Rest ohne belastbare Elementbedeutung.
design.target_endpoint: Das bereits zugelassene vollständige f66r-Randobjekt in GDT957 mit 15 Randformen und drei bereits verglichenen IT-Ausgaben; alle Formen, Chartkandidaten und Tabellen sind bereits im bestehenden GDT957-Scope, ohne neue Zielauswahl oder neue Datenaufnahme.

summary: Nach der bereits erfolgten GDT957-Auswertung ist beobachtet worden, dass die f66r-Formfamilie rary/dary/fary denselben vollständigen Rest ary nach wechselndem Anfang zeigt. Eine neue, ausdrücklich post-exposure Hypothese wäre, dass ary eine Elementklasse trägt; die drei beobachteten FIRE-Zuordnungen unter zwei vorhandenen IT-Charts sind nur ein Anlass, kein Befund.
title: RAW_POST_EXPOSURE_UNREVIEWED: gemeinsamer ary-Rest als mögliche Elementklasse

assumption_costs: Turner 1655 ist ein später, pseudo-Agrippa zugeschriebener Text; seine Hausmatrix ist eine historische Vergleichsquelle, kein Voynich-Codebuch.
Für den Zieltest müssten Formwiederholungen und ihre Positionsrollen bereits unabhängig feststehen; fehlende Wiederholung lässt die Karte ungetestet.
Die zahlreichen Aussagen pro Figur/Haus dürfen nicht nachträglich so ausgewählt werden, dass eine gewünschte Glosse passt.
Hausposition und Inhaltsdomäne müssen aus Zielstruktur oder einer vorab gebundenen Quelle kommen, nicht aus der behaupteten Übersetzung.
design.budget: 30 Minuten total nach Abschluss des Root-Vollvergleichs: 5 Minuten Rollen-/Formfamilienliste, 15 Minuten quellenfixierte Figuren-Haus-Kreuzung, 5 Minuten rivalisierende Globalglosse, 5 Minuten unabhängige Falsifikatorprüfung; bei fehlenden Wiederholungen sofort stoppen.
design.external_primary: Robert Turner, Of Geomancy (1655), zugeschrieben Agrippa, vollständige Transkription, besonders Häuser und Fortuna-major-Beispiele: https://www.princeton.edu/~ezb/geomancy/agrippa.html
design.falsifier: Eine bereits zugelassene vollständige Form, die in zwei verschiedenen Rollenpositionen vorkommt und unter der vorab fixierten Quellenmatrix denselben Inhaltsbereich ohne Perspektivwechsel erzwingt, widerlegt die behauptete notwendige Positionsabhängigkeit für diesen Scope.
design.mechanism: Die Bedeutung ist ein Paar aus Figurenwert und Positions-/Hausrolle. Eine wiederkehrende Figur bleibt formal identisch, wechselt aber mit dem Haus den Inhaltsbereich und kann sogar die Perspektive auf Querent oder Gegner umkehren. Der Positionsparameter ist daher semantisch wirksam, nicht bloße Anordnung.
design.nearest_rival: GDT957s stabile/injektive Figuren-Key-Lesung und IDEA000329s ary-Elementklassenhypothese. Diese Karte behauptet keine Elementklasse und keine globale Wortbedeutung, sondern einen Positionsparameter.
design.observable_difference: A sagt bei einer bereits vorhandenen Formwiederholung über verschiedene zugelassene Positionsrollen mindestens zwei verschiedene Inhaltsdomänen oder eine Perspektivumkehr voraus, ohne die Form selbst zu ändern. B verlangt dieselbe Inhaltsglosse in beiden Positionen. Ein einzelner Formfund, eine seltene Position oder eine nachträglich gesetzte Hausbedeutung genügt nicht.
design.reading_a: Positionsabhängige Inhaltslesung: Ein wiederverwendetes Form-/Figurensignal erhält seinen Inhaltsbereich aus der aktuellen Haus-/Rollenposition. Eine Wiederholung in unterschiedlichen Positionen darf deshalb unterschiedliche, aber quellenkonform relationale Aussagen tragen; die letzten Rollen können den Gegenstand oder die Schlussrichtung ändern.
design.reading_b: Stabile Globalglosse: Jede Form benennt stets dasselbe Objekt, dieselbe Eigenschaft oder dasselbe Ergebnis; Haus-/Positionsunterschiede sind Layout oder Reihenfolge und ändern den Inhalt nicht.
design.smallest_test: Nach Root-GDT957s unabhängigem Vollvergleich nur die schon zugelassenen 15 Gruppen und vorhandenen Wiederholungsfamilien kreuzen: vor jeder Glosse prüfen, ob eine Form in mindestens zwei Rollenpositionen vorkommt und ob die Quellenmatrix dafür zwei verschiedene Domänen vorgibt. Bei keinen Wiederholungen ist die Hypothese nicht ausführbar; keine neuen Zielstellen oder Schlüssel ergänzen.
design.source_example: Turner beschreibt für Fortuna major verschiedene konkrete Folgen in Haus 2 (Substanz/Reichtum), Haus 6 (Krankheit und Arzt), Haus 7 (Ehe/Streit; bei einer Frage über die Gegner wird dieselbe Figur gegnerbezogen) und weiteren Häusern. Der Primärtext sagt im Haus-2-Eintrag: "In the second House, he signifies substance, riches, poverty, gain and loss". Dies ist eine echte Figur-Haus-Kreuzung, keine bloße Umbenennung; der Zeuge ist jedoch spät und pseudo-Agrippa.
design.strongest_likely_failure: Die 15 f66r-Gruppen bieten keine wiederholte Form über verschiedene Rollen oder keine unabhängig gebundene Hausposition; dann sind stabile Globalglosse und positionsabhängige Kreuzung empirisch nicht zu trennen.
design.target_endpoint: Das bereits zugelassene vollständige f66r-Randobjekt in GDT957 und die dortige 15-Gruppen-Ordnung; keine GDT957-Schlüssel, Zielmappings oder neuen Zielstellen werden hier geöffnet.

summary: Turners spät überlieferte Geomantie weist derselben Figur je nach Haus unterschiedliche Inhaltsfolgen zu: Fortuna major betrifft etwa Substanz im zweiten, Krankheit/Heilung im sechsten und Gegner im siebten Haus. Das ist eine neue, positionsabhängige Inhaltsrivalität zur stabilen Globalglosse und geht über den ary-Elementrest hinaus.
title: RAW_POST_EXPOSURE_UNREVIEWED: geomantische Figur-Haus-Paare als Inhaltswechsel

assumption_costs: The target paragraph boundaries are independently fixed.
The manuscript could contain documentary or administrative records.
No target word is assigned an English legal gloss; only ordered role slots are compared.
design.falsifier: A complete target candidate with independently marked boundaries repeatedly places the alleged witness/agent stage before the act/object or lacks any terminal documentary stage while the charter model requires one.
design.mechanism: A paragraph is a documentary act with typed stages: issuer and grant, transferred right/object, restriction or protection, attestation, and agent/date closure.
design.nearest_rival: A practical instruction or inventory whose final names are materials, operations, or results rather than witnesses to an act.

primary_sources.locator: Electronic Sawyer S 454, Latin and translation, lines 42-47
primary_sources.source_limit: Institutional digital edition; the charter is dated A.D. 924 x 939 and one manuscript witness is a seventeenth-century copy.

design.smallest_distinguishing_observation: On a later target-held paragraph, a source-like reading must predict an ordered act/object/protection/attestation chain with a terminal witness or agent role; a catalogue/recipe rival predicts no such terminal documentary closure.
design.source_example: Electronic Sawyer S 454, A.D. 924 x 939, lines 42-47: Æthelstan grants customs and five hides, directs protection from claims, records his mark and named witnesses, then names Godwine as procurator.
design.strongest_likely_failure: A target paragraph may have no author-visible witness/date markers, making the charter sequence indistinguishable from a generic list and leaving this as a source analogy only.
design.target_endpoint: Already admitted complete paragraph cache summarized by GDT928; no target text or labels were opened for this proposal.

consequences: A whole paragraph should preserve issuer/act before object, and object before witness or agent closure.
A protection or exception clause should modify the grant and be followed by attestation, rather than behaving as another peer item.
two_readings.name: documentary transfer

consequences: Entries may list objects or actions without a required witness/agent terminal stage.
Reordering or omitting the apparent authority and attestation stages need not change the content relation.
two_readings.name: descriptive or procedural list

summary: A complete Æthelstan charter supplies a finite administrative chain: authority/grant, object and extent, protection clause, then witnesses and procurator. This offers a paragraph-level content rival to recipe or catalogue prose.
title: A charter-style record separates authority, transfer, protection, and attestation

assumption_costs: The target contains complete Herbal records with independently recognizable branch and result positions.
A first-century Greek pharmacological entry is a relevant content analogue for the manuscript.
The 1933 English translation is treated as a guide to relations, not a target lexicon or modern plant identification.
design.falsifier: A source-frozen target model repeatedly links the same material component to only one role or treats an independently marked excess branch as the same result without an explicit exception operator.
design.mechanism: One source item is carried through alternative preparation operators; each branch has a distinct application/result, and an excess condition reverses the ordinary benefit with a named harm.
design.nearest_rival: A plant/material catalogue with neighboring preparation notes, where shared material forms reflect editorial reuse rather than one item branching through state and outcome.

primary_sources.locator: Dioscorides, De materia medica I.3 Meum, printed p. 5
primary_sources.source_limit: English translation/edition based on John Goodyer's 1655 translation and Gunther's 1933 edition; exact Greek wording and plant identity remain outside this card.

design.smallest_distinguishing_observation: A complete target record would need one reused material component linked to at least two distinct preparation/application roles and a separately marked conditional reversal; exact whole-word identity is unnecessary, but the branch and result positions must be fixed before reading.
design.source_example: Dioscorides, De materia medica I.3 (UPenn/Gunther edition, printed p. 5): Meum roots are boiled or pounded and drunk; pounded with honey as syrup; boiled for a hip bath; plastered on children; too much decoction causes headache.
design.strongest_likely_failure: The target has no independently bound adverse-result or preparation branch marker; any apparent repeated core could be ordinary component reuse and the source cannot select among content genres.
design.target_endpoint: Already admitted Herbal complete-paragraph cache; no target text, labels, or new selectors were opened.

consequences: A repeated material core may feed different operation/application slots, with downstream result type changing by branch.
An explicit excess/exception branch must produce an adverse result rather than the ordinary treatment outcome.
two_readings.name: branching preparation record

consequences: The same material can recur beside unrelated procedures without a shared branch source.
The adverse statement is an independent warning and need not be tied to the preceding preparation or result.
two_readings.name: static item and procedure list

summary: Dioscorides' Meum entry explicitly gives boiled or pounded roots, honey syrup, hip bath, plaster, and an excessive-decoction adverse effect. The content distinction is branch structure, not repeated plant-name equality.
title: A Dioscorides entry branches one root into preparations, effects, and an overdose result

assumption_costs: Complete paragraph order and any status/permission markers can be fixed independently.
A monastic regulatory text is a relevant model for a possible metatextual or procedural register.
The source roles remain unglossed target placeholders; no moral or religious meaning is assigned.
design.falsifier: On source-frozen complete target paragraphs, a purported status trigger is followed by no stable demotion/repair relation, or permission repeatedly removes rather than delays the repair stage.
design.mechanism: An institutional rule tracks an actor's status across an event: trigger, sanction/placement, repair, and restored participation, with an explicit authority-conditioned exception.
design.nearest_rival: A recipe or service instruction in which ordered actions have no institutional actor status and a permission clause simply selects an alternative action.

primary_sources.locator: Rule of Benedict, chapter 43, On those who come late to the Work of God or to table
primary_sources.source_limit: Modern English translation of the early medieval rule; this card uses its explicit conditional and status sequence, not a target vocabulary.

design.smallest_distinguishing_observation: A later target paragraph would have to preserve a trigger-to-demotion-to-repair-to-reentry chain, and an authority-conditioned branch would alter only re-entry timing. A generic process/list reading predicts no such state carry.
design.source_example: Rule of Benedict, chapter 43: after the office signal, a late arrival after the Gloria stands last or in a designated place until public penance; at day hours the abbot may permit joining the choir, but satisfaction remains due afterward.
design.strongest_likely_failure: No target-visible sanction, authority, or re-entry relation may be independently owned; the chain could then be imposed on any ordered prose.
design.target_endpoint: Already admitted complete paragraph cache summarized by GDT928; target text and candidate forms were not opened.

consequences: A trigger must precede a visible placement/status change, then a repair or satisfaction stage before normal participation resumes.
The permission exception changes the timing of re-entry but does not erase the later repair obligation.
two_readings.name: status-transition rule

consequences: Late/early phrases can be temporal instructions without a persistent status state.
A permission clause can replace the following action entirely, with no required repair or re-entry relation.
two_readings.name: ordinary procedural sequence

summary: Rule of Benedict chapter 43 gives a complete status transition: late arrival after a signal leads to last-place placement, public penance, and re-entry; an abbot's permission creates a bounded exception with later satisfaction.
title: A monastic rule encodes fault, visible demotion, satisfaction, and conditional re-entry

assumption_costs: Target operation, route, duration, and exception/alternate-object positions can be fixed without English glosses.
A compiled Greek magical-medical chapter is a relevant content analogue for an admitted target passage.
The decan clause and amulet are allowed to be a source-linked branch but are not assumed to be one causal theory.
design.falsifier: A source-frozen target model repeatedly separates part/effect/duration from every exception or alternate-object route, or treats the alleged contrary branch as the same ordinary outcome without a marked scope change.
design.mechanism: A reusable botanical material is typed by part and route, receives bodily/flow effects plus explicit durations or amounts, and can switch to a contrary or astral-conditioned wearable branch with a stone/fish alternative.
design.nearest_rival: An editorially heterogeneous medical recipe and occult-note compendium, or a flat plant catalogue with local duration and substitution fields.

primary_sources.locator: Cyranides Book I, chapter 1, sections 1-39; Greek digital edition based on the 1898 edition
primary_sources.source_limit: Digital Greek edition/transcription and compiled text; source architecture does not establish a Voynich identification or a single coherent causal theory.

design.smallest_distinguishing_observation: In a complete source-frozen target passage, one reusable component must link a part-specific bodily/flow operation and fixed time/amount to a separately marked contrary or astral/amulet route switch; the rival predicts independent frame distribution.
design.source_example: Cyranides Book I chapter 1, sections 1-10, 18, 21, 23 and 35-39: white vine root/leaf/stem/fruit operations, seven-day and other durations, stone mixture preventing recurrence, first-decan Capricorn quartan cause, grape-seed neck amulet and fish-stone alternative.
design.strongest_likely_failure: The target may have medical procedures but no astral/amulet register, or the source's mixed compilation may not encode one cross-register chain; then the proposed relation cannot beat the heterogeneous rival.
design.target_endpoint: Already admitted complete paragraph/content caches summarized by GDT928/GDT735; no target text, labels, images, or new selectors were opened.

consequences: A material/part relation should control a bodily or flow result together with an amount or duration, without requiring one whole-word name.
A marked contrary or decan branch should change route from ingestive treatment to a wearable botanical/stone alternative while retaining a relation to the disease or recurrence condition.
two_readings.name: compound timed medical-astral regimen

consequences: Medical part/route/effect/duration frames can recur independently of astral or amulet frames.
The stone/fish substitution and decan clause need not scope over the preceding plant treatments; recurrence alone carries no cross-register link.
two_readings.name: heterogeneous medical and occult compendium

summary: A complete Cyranides I.1 chain distinguishes plant part, preparation/route, bodily or flow effect, amount/duration, a mixture that prevents worsening/return, and a later decan-linked quartan-disease amulet branch. This is a source-specific content graph beyond plant-name incidence.
title: Cyranides I.1 binds plant-part flow treatments to duration and an astral/amulet exception

design.contrast: bounded material/part frame with quantity-to-content attachment and content-to-endpoint order versus pairwise amount attachment, operation-count, or independent field-entry rivals
design.countermodel: The apparent sandwich may be a layout convention, repeated action sequence, or renderer-inherited working label. A closure-looking whole may be another item, and cheor/sheor or cheo/sheo may be quality/state forms rather than content names.
design.decision_consequence: A positive bounded relation would justify testing occurrence-scoped material/part readings only inside three-link frames and would weaken free global readings of quantity-adjacent wholes. A null result would retain GDT760's position-conditioned pairwise attachment as an exploratory observation without upgrading it to a content grammar.
design.falsifier: After preregistering exact whole boundaries, line-position strata, entry-context strata, and an endpoint definition, held frames show no excess of the ordered three-way relation over matched operation/count and independent-field controls, or the relation reverses across strata without a predeclared explanation.
design.mechanism: three-sided quantity-content-closure scoping over exact whole forms
design.prediction: Across held complete frames, the material/part account predicts a stable ordered quantity -> content -> endpoint relation after conditioning on line position and entry context. The operation/count rival predicts quantity contact without a stable content-to-endpoint link; the independent-field rival predicts no three-way frame excess after the same context controls.
design.principal_risk: GDT760's material/preparation labels and endpoint candidates are working interpretations, not independently translated Voynich meanings. The design must preserve them as explicit rival annotations and cannot claim a named ingredient or closure lexeme.
design.related: Near GDT760 and IDEA000010 (pairwise amount attachment), but distinct because it requires a predeclared third content-to-endpoint link and tests a three-way frame against an operation/count rival; not a rerun of pairwise side attachment.
design.smallest_next_step: Using already cached, admitted artifacts only, enumerate complete frames with exact quantity and endpoint boundaries, freeze independently justified context strata and content-rival labels, then run a held three-way relation count against matched pairwise and independent-field controls; stop if no endpoint can be defined without inherited renderer meaning.

design.contrast: a directed opener -> content-pivot -> closer frame versus independent formal edge carriers, a pure boundary field, or a W-capacity artifact
design.countermodel: Exterior profiles may be purely positional, and the atomic residual may encode frequency or mobility rather than content. A field can be a title, amount, or diagram label with the same opener/closer shape; W membership is not a word class.
design.decision_consequence: A positive result would make a complete directed carrier chain the minimum unit for any later content reading and would prohibit component-by-component word translation. A null would preserve GDT607/608 as formal composition findings while abandoning the content-pivot extension.
design.falsifier: After freezing complete field boundaries, role labels, whole identity, and matched frequency/mobility controls, the joint chain does not outperform component-only, atomic-only, and permuted-residual rivals on held fields, or its advantage disappears when entry context is held out.
design.mechanism: joint exterior-role chain plus whole-form residual identity

source_meaning_ownership.I.1: Iris leaves resemble ξιφίῳ but are larger, broader and fleshier; flowers/colours and the celestial Iris naming explanation remain in the full opening sentence.
source_meaning_ownership.I.2: Acoron leaves resemble Iris but are narrower. The subsequent roots clause is separately scoped; the later as-Iris sitz-bath comparison is a use relation, not leaf width.
source_meaning_ownership.IV.20: Xiphion is also reportedly called φασγάνιον and μαχαιρίων because of leaf shape; it resembles Iris but is smaller/narrower, sharp like a small knife and fibrous. No modern taxon or literal-sword normalization.
source_meaning_ownership.alias_policy: Reported alternative names are aliases, not new independently observed species. Iris-of-the-sky is a different referent from the plant. Morphology and treatment comparisons cannot be pooled by name recurrence alone.

source_owned_examples.complete_main_text: 1 ἶρις Ἰλλυρικὴ φύλλα φέρει ὅμοια ξιφίῳ, μείζονα δὲ καὶ πλατύτερα καὶ λιπαρώτερα, ἄνθη ἐπὶ καυλῶν παράλληλα, ἐπικαμπῆ, ποικίλα· ἢ γὰρ λευκὰ ἢ ὠχρὰ ἢ μήλινα ἢ πορφυρᾶ ἢ κυανίζοντα ὁρᾶται, ὅθεν διὰ τὴν ποικιλίαν ἀπεικάσθη Ἴριδι οὐρανίᾳ. ῥίζαι δὲ ὕπεισι γονατώδεις, στερεαί, εὐώδεις, ἃς δεῖ μετὰ τὴν τομὴν ξηράναντας ἐν σκιᾷ καὶ διείραντας λίνῳ ἀποτίθεσθαι. ἔστι δὲ βελτίων ἡ Ἰλλυρικὴ καὶ Μακεδονική, καὶ ταύτης ἀρίστη ἡ πυκνόρριζος καὶ ὑποκόλοβος καὶ δύσθραυστος καὶ τῇ χρόᾳ ὑπόκιρρος καὶ σφόδρα εὐώδης καὶ τῇ γεύσει πυρω δεστέρα τήν τε ὀσμὴν εἰλικρινὴς καὶ μὴ νοτίζουσα πταρμούς τε ἐν τῷ κόπτεσθαι κινοῦσα. ἡ δὲ Λιβυκὴ λευκή τέ ἐστι τὴν χρόαν τῇ τε γεύσει πικρά, δευτερεύουσα δὲ τῇ δυνάμει. παλαιούμεναι δὲ τερηδονίζονται, εὐωδέστεραι μέντοι τότε γίνονται. 2 δύναμιν δὲ ἔχουσι πᾶσαι θερμαντικήν, λεπτυντικήν, ἁρμόζουσαι πρὸς βῆχας καὶ τὰ δυσανάγωγα ὑγρὰ λεπτοποιοῦσαι. καθαίρουσι δὲ πάχη καὶ χολὰς ποτιζόμεναι μεθ᾿ ὑδρομέλιτος δραχμῶν ἑπτά. εἰσὶ δὲ καὶ ὑπνοποιοὶ καὶ δακρυοποιοὶ καὶ στρόφους ἰῶνται. μετ᾿ ὄξους δὲ πινόμεναι θηριοδήκτοις ἀρήγουσι καὶ σπληνικοῖς καὶ σπωμένοις καὶ περιψυχομένοις ἢ ῥιγοῦσι καὶ τοῖς γόνον προιεμένοις, σὺν οἴνῳ δὲ ποθεῖσαι ἄγουσιν ἔμμηνα. καὶ τὸ ἀπόζεμα δὲ αὐτῶν πρὸς γυναικείας πυρίας εὔθετον, μαλάσσον τοὺς τόπους καὶ ἀναστομοῦν, ἰσχιάδος τε ἔγκλυσμα, καὶ συρίγγων καὶ κόλπων σαρκωτικόν. προστεθεῖσαι 3 δὲ ὡς κολλύριον μετὰ μέλιτος ἔμβρυα κατασπῶσι, καὶ μαλάσσουσι δὲ χοιράδας καὶ σκιρρώματα παλαιὰ ἑφθαὶ καταπλασθεῖσαι. ξηραὶ δὲ πληροῦσιν ἕλκη καὶ ἀνακαθαίρουσι μετὰ μέλιτος καὶ τὰ ἐψιλωμένα τῶν ὀστέων σαρκοῦσιν. ὠφελοῦσι δὲ καὶ κεφαλαλγίας σὺν ὄξει καὶ ῥοδίνῳ καταπλασθεῖσαι, φακούς τε καὶ ἐφήλεις ἀποκαθαίρουσι σὺν ἐλλεβόρῳ λευκῷ διπλασίονι καὶ μέλιτι καταχρισθεῖσαι. μείγνυνται δὲ καὶ πεσσοῖς καὶ μαλάγμασι καὶ ἀκόποις, καὶ καθόλου εἰσὶ πολύχρηστοι.

design.mechanism: One shared content semantics maintains integer numerator/denominator identity through multiplication, exact simultaneous cancellation, division with remainder, equivalence assertions and a claimed greatest common measure or fully reduced result. Paths may differ in operation order and length while denoting one rational value. Coprimeness/maximality is an additional meaningful condition, not implied by endpoint value equality.
design.retained_counterexamples: GDT971 known-role/digit-map source control and free-whole-quantity labels remain: correct arithmetic under known role boundaries does not identify target numbers, and a second path need not add discrimination in a chosen code family. Without an explicit lowest-terms/maximality claim,6/10 is a valid answer and must not be called false. Multiple operation paths and equivalent fractions remain legitimate.

constraints: CANCEL(k,a,b) requires k>0 integer and exact divisibility of both a and b; replace by a/k,b/k.
Fractions retain ordered numerator and denominator and one globally shared numeric interpretation.
Division relation a=q*b+r has nonnegative integer q,r and0<=r<b.
A common-measure claim divides both original integers; a greatest claim additionally needs a complete certificate.

summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED. Complete line sair chey losaiin chey is read prospectively as “Halve the whole; halve its half.” Three shared whole-word hypotheses give a conditional quarter outcome.
